assets.prompt: A row of 16x16 frames of a grass tuft standing on its foot at the frame's bottom middle, every frame drawn from the same pointy blades (two pixels at the foot tapering to one, curving outward; Leaf's shadow for the blades behind and at the foot, Leaf's base for the blades in front; no lit tips). Frames 0-5: six tufts at rest (fan, tall and spiky, low and bushy, windswept, arched, a short dense clump). Frames 6-7: two trampled (blades pressed flat and splayed along the floor). Then, for each stage of the grass's fire, a strip of frames for each of the six tufts in that order, each tuft keeping its own blades and each stage ending where the next begins: catching, 5 frames of flames climbing the green blades from a dark red foot (Fire's dark red, base and light); burning, 6 frames of the blades as flames burning down (Fire's shades and a white-hot Spark tip), a flame's tongue on alternate blades flickering; smouldering, 5 frames of charred Stone stubs whose Fire embers die into the ash; ash, 1 frame of low Stone stubs; growing, 6 frames of the green blades growing out of the ash back to the tuft at rest; going out, 3 frames of the flames shrinking down the green blades. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no outline (floor decoration), light from the top-left.
